name: Payments Platform
description: Owns all payment processing infrastructure, Payments API, and Billing Engine. Responsible for PCI-DSS compliance and payment gateway integrations.

name: Identity
description: Owns authentication, authorisation, and the Identity Service. Manages SSO integrations and RBAC policies across the platform.

name: Data Platform
description: Owns the Data Pipeline, analytics infrastructure, and data warehouse. Responsible for data quality, ETL reliability, and the customer-facing Analytics Dashboard.

name: Customer Success
description: Owns the Customer Portal and Notification Service. Responsible for customer-facing features, onboarding flows, and SLA monitoring.

name: SRE
description: Site Reliability Engineering. Owns the Search Service, shared observability stack, incident response process, and on-call rotation. Partners with every product team on reliability.

name: Analytics
description: Owns business intelligence tooling, the Analytics Dashboard, and self-service reporting infrastructure. Partners with Data Platform on data modelling.
